# glesys_blockstorage (Resource)
Block storage volume.
## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "glesys_blockstorage" "datadisk" {
  name       = "extra storage"
  datacenter = "dc-fbg1"
  size       = 200
  tier       = "velocity"
  serverid   = "kvm123456"
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Volume location.
- `name` (String) Volume descriptive name.
- `size` (Number) Volume size in GIB.

### Optional

- `serverid` (String) Attached `glesys_server` id.
- `status` (String) Volume status.
- `tier` (String) Volume storage class tier [capacity|balanced|velocity].
- `wwn` (String) Volume WWN id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Volume ID.
## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
# glesys_blockstorage Import
$ terraform import glesys_blockstorage.example bsv-abc123
```
